name: circle-to-search
title: Circle to Search
description: Circle any area on your screen to search visually with Google Lens, Bing, Yandex, or TinEye
author: yetemgetaB

preferences.name: searchEngine
preferences.title: Default Search Engine
preferences.description: Choose which visual search engine opens when circling an image

commands.name: search-screen
commands.title: Circle Screen to Search
commands.description: Dims the screen with a precision reticle cursor to let you freehand circle any area to search visually

commands.name: search-clipboard
commands.title: Search Clipboard Image
commands.description: Searches the image currently copied to your clipboard visually

commands.name: search-fullscreen
commands.title: Search Full Screen
commands.description: Takes a full screen snapshot and searches it visually

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.readdirSync('dist').filter(f => f.endsWith('.js') || f.endsWith('.js.map')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('dist/' + f, f))"
